_meta.bodyNature: DICTATION reference — the exact steps to TYPE into Manage Scripts. NOT paste-round-trippable; FileMaker's script clipboard is XML.
_meta.keying: Script names are unique per FileMaker file, so name is a safe graph key.
_meta.callsResolution: calls[] targets scripts in this file. calledBy is DERIVED at render time, never stored.

scripts.name: API test
scripts.note: Scratch test script at root level.

scripts.name: refresh | Target_Tables
scripts.note: App catalog refresh. Body lives on the standards shelf; this app installs it under its own name.

scripts.name: refresh | xt_fields
scripts.note: Generic field-refresh dispatcher. Resolves a container's system and performs that system's adapter.

scripts.name: adapter | refresh cu_Fields
scripts.note: The only script that knows ClickUp's custom-field endpoint. Fills xt_FIELDS names and types.

scripts.name: sync RUN
scripts.note: The button. One context join, one session, pull then dispatch then push.

scripts.name: adapter PULL | ClickUp
scripts.note: Pages a ClickUp view, caches tasks in xt_RECORDS, writes pull events for new/changed tasks. Dev cap at page 0.

scripts.name: sync DISPATCH
scripts.note: Walks pulled records and calls the handler for the container's target table.

scripts.name: PERSON_Upsert_From_xtRecord
scripts.note: Adopt or three-way compare. Creates PEOPLE + CONTACTS + join on adoption.

scripts.name: RECONCILE_Apply
scripts.note: Acts on decided sync_RECONCILE rows. XT rows write to FileMaker, FM rows queue for push.

scripts.name: adapter PUSH | ClickUp
scripts.note: Pushes FileMaker edits back to ClickUp. One person or every person FileMaker has moved.

scripts.name: PEOPLE_Pull
scripts.supersededWhy: Pre-sync-plan import script. Replaced by adapter PULL | ClickUp.

scripts.name: RECONCILE_SetII
scripts.supersededWhy: Pre-sync-plan reconcile helper. Replaced by RECONCILE_Apply.

scripts.name: RECONCILE_SetAll
scripts.supersededWhy: Pre-sync-plan reconcile helper. Replaced by RECONCILE_Apply.

scripts.name: PEOPLE_Compare
scripts.supersededWhy: Pre-sync-plan compare. Three-way compare now handled by PERSON_Upsert_From_xtRecord.

scripts.name: RECONCILE_ShowSession
scripts.supersededWhy: Pre-sync-plan session viewer. sync RUN now navigates to the session at close.
